name: lawntvdecomp
description: Decompiled reconstruction of the Plants vs. Zombies TV/Android build (libGameMain.so)

$comment-dependencies.sdl3: Window creation, input, game controllers and audio device/stream output. Replaces GLFW and OpenAL Soft in the platform layer; existing codecs continue to decode audio to PCM.
$comment-dependencies.sdl3-net: Portable hostname resolution and typed sockets for the existing logging interfaces.
$comment-dependencies.bgfx: Cross-platform rendering backend replacing direct OpenGL and glad. Enables multithreaded rendering and the shaderc, texturec and geometryc tools for the native Windows build.
$comment-dependencies.glm: Matrix/vector math for the transform pipeline (SexyMatrix3 / SexyTransform2D / SexyMatrix4).
$comment-dependencies.sdl3-image: Primary image decoder producing CPU surfaces for upload to bgfx. PNG and JPEG features bring libpng and libjpeg-turbo as transitive dependencies.
$comment-dependencies.zlib: Inflate for .pak archives and compressed resource streams.
$comment-dependencies.minizip-ng: Reads the .zip pak files under assets/paks (PakLib::ZipFileSystem).
$comment-dependencies.bzip2: Secondary compression used by some pak entries.
$comment-dependencies.libogg: OGG container parsing for the Music2 streaming path.
$comment-dependencies.libvorbis: Vorbis decoding. Music2 loads 11 OGG tracks and is the default music path.
$comment-dependencies.libopenmpt: Tracker music decoding and channel control for the existing music path; decoded PCM is sent to SDL3 audio.
$comment-dependencies.nlohmann-json: JSON parsing for DataSync / JSONNode / userdata.
$comment-dependencies.pugixml: XML parsing for levels/levels-*.xml, properties/*.xml and defaultSetting.xml.
$comment-dependencies.stb: Fallback image decoding for formats such as PSD, HDR and Softimage PIC.
